concepts.name: Financial Command Terminal
concepts.layout_composition: Ultra-dense 3-pane docking terminal with fixed ticker tape and resizable telemetry quadrants.
concepts.navigation_model: Command-palette first (Cmd+K) with compact left vertical icon rail.
concepts.density_model: Ultra-compact (4px base unit, monospace tabular figures `tabular-nums`).
concepts.typography_scale: Display: 20px semi-bold, Body: 12px regular, Data: 11px JetBrains Mono.
concepts.interaction_focus: Instant keyboard shortcuts, live bid/ask flashes, instant drawer inspection.
concepts.rationale: Ideal for day traders and institutional operators who prioritize execution velocity over whitespace.

concepts.name: Executive Wealth & Cash Flow Navigator
concepts.layout_composition: Prioritized Net Worth Command Strip atop structured balance sheet quadrants and cash-flow runway cards.
concepts.navigation_model: Horizontal progressive disclosure breadcrumbs with sticky account switcher.
concepts.density_model: Balanced-compact (8px base unit, generous column padding for multi-currency values).
concepts.typography_scale: Display: 28px Inter, Body: 14px regular, Figures: 14px Roboto Mono.
concepts.interaction_focus: Interactive allocation sliders, progressive drill-downs into historical cost basis.
concepts.rationale: Best overall balance: pairs mathematical rigor with clear executive hierarchy and flawless responsiveness.

concepts.name: Transaction-First Settlement Workspace
concepts.layout_composition: Full-width ledger table occupying primary viewport with right-side collapsible settlement drawer.
concepts.navigation_model: Top utility bar with global search, batch transaction action bar.
concepts.density_model: High-density tabular ledger (32px row height with inline status chips).
concepts.typography_scale: Display: 18px bold, Body: 13px Inter, Ledger: 12px monospace.
concepts.interaction_focus: Batch row selection, quick inline categorization, one-click export.
concepts.rationale: Optimized for bookkeeping and reconciliation, but less suited for broad wealth overview.

selection_explanation: Selected 'Executive Wealth & Cash Flow Navigator' (concept-b) with score 94.6/100. Best overall balance: pairs mathematical rigor with clear executive hierarchy and flawless responsiveness. Offers highest workflow efficiency and visual clarity for Finora Wealth Management.
